readings.candidate_not_current_cell: the rover's current cell is never a candidate (else it would 'reach' it at once, forever)
readings.feasible_before_top_k: the K = 30 coarse shortlist is taken among feasible candidates; first-pass feasibility uses the coarse quantities E[s->q] (E[c] summed along the c' tree from s) and E[q->home] (E[c] home field); the chosen candidate is re-checked with E[c] summed along its traced outbound path, else the next by score (manager 12th update)
readings.return_for_gain: the return path used for G(q) is planned on c' as it is at selection time (seen cells so far)
readings.outbound_lookahead: outbound: the version-2 'cost x2 ahead' path replan is replaced by R5's 1.5x reselect; an impassable cell on the remaining path triggers a reselect at once
readings.score_home_term: E[q->home] in score and feasibility = least E[c] cost home (same as the coarse value)
readings.margin_expected: margin denominator: E[c] of each driven step's two cells as unseen cells, with p_k current at that step
